    every C++ statement maps almost 1:1 to asm), FULL symbol table (no DWARF for the library though).
  - It statically contains Clipper2 v2.0.1 (namespace Clipper2Lib) plus a small main().
  - Templates are instantiated for Point<long> (= Point64, {int64 x; int64 y}, 16 bytes) and Point<double>.
  - libc/libstdc++ are dynamically linked. std::vector<T> layout is libstdc++: {T* begin; T* end; T* cap} = 24 bytes.

  - /workspace/notes/dis.sh 'NamePattern'        # disassemble every function whose demangled name matches; callees demangled

  - perl -e 'printf("%.17g\n", unpack("d", pack("Q", 0x4000000000000000)))'   # decode a double bit pattern
  - To read a constant at a virtual address, use objdump, e.g.:
      objdump -s -j .rodata --start-address=0x431970 --stop-address=0x431980 /workspace/dataset/test20_executable

# Clipper2 v2.0.1 — auxiliary struct layouts + join machinery (from `/workspace/dataset/test20_executable`)

All facts below are derived from the disassembly only. Addresses are virtual (non-PIE, base 0x400000).
`std::vector<T>` = 24 bytes `{T* begin; T* end; T* cap}`.

---

## 1. `Clipper2Lib::HorzSegment` — 24 bytes, align 8

| off  | size | field           | type          | evidence |
|------|------|-----------------|---------------|----------|
| 0x00 | 8    | `left_op`       | `OutPt*`      | ctor `0x41452a`: `mov %rdx,(%rax)` stores the `OutPt*` param |
| 0x08 | 8    | `right_op`      | `OutPt*`      | ctor `0x414531`: `movq $0x0,0x8(%rax)` |
| 0x10 | 1    | `left_to_right` | `bool`        | ctor `0x41453d`: `movb $0x1,0x10(%rax)`; read as `movzbl 0x10(%rax)` in ConvertHorzSegsToJoins (`0x41114f`, `0x4111c8`) |
| 0x11 | 7    | (padding)       |               | |

`sizeof == 24` proven twice: `new_allocator<HorzSegment>::allocate` (`0x423f82..0x423f8b`) computes
`n*3` then `shl $3` = `n*24`; `new_allocator<HorzSegment>::construct` (`0x41edfd`) does
`operator new(0x18, p)`. `max_size() = 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA` = (2^64-1)/24.

### `HorzSegment::HorzSegment(OutPt* op)` — 0x414516
```
left_op = op;  right_op = nullptr;  left_to_right = true;
```

### `SetHorzSegHeadingForward(HorzSegment& hs, OutPt* opP, OutPt* opZ)` — 0x415e05 → `bool`
`OutPt::pt.x` is at offset 0 of `OutPt`.
```
if (opP->pt.x == opZ->pt.x) return false;            // 0x415e23 cmp / jne
if (opP->pt.x <  opZ->pt.x) {                        // 0x415e3d cmp; jge -> else branch
    hs.left_op = opP; hs.right_op = opZ; hs.left_to_right = true;
} else {
    hs.left_op = opZ; hs.right_op = opP; hs.left_to_right = false;
}
return true;
```

### `UpdateHorzSegment(HorzSegment& hs)` — 0x415e89 → `bool`
Offsets used: `OutPt{ pt@0(x@0,y@8), next@0x10, prev@0x18, outrec@0x20, horz@0x28 }`,
`OutRec{ front_edge@0x10, pts@0x20 }`.
```
OutPt*  op        = hs.left_op;                       // 0x415e99
OutRec* outrec    = GetRealOutRec(op->outrec);        // 0x415ea4 (+0x20), call 0x414f31
bool has_edges    = (outrec->front_edge != nullptr);  // 0x415eb8 (+0x10), setne
int64_t curr_y    = op->pt.y;                         // 0x415ec9 (+0x8)
OutPt *op_p = op, *op_n = op;                         // 0x415ed5 / 0x415edd
if (has_edges) {
    OutPt* opA = outrec->pts;                         // 0x415eeb (+0x20)
    OutPt* opZ = opA->next;                           // 0x415ef7 (+0x10)
    while (op_p != opZ && op_p->prev->pt.y == curr_y) op_p = op_p->prev;  // 0x415eff..0x415f27
    while (op_n != opA && op_n->next->pt.y == curr_y) op_n = op_n->next;  // 0x415f29..0x415f51
} else {
    while (op_p->prev != op_n && op_p->prev->pt.y == curr_y) op_p = op_p->prev; // 0x415f53..
    while (op_n->next != op_p && op_n->next->pt.y == curr_y) op_n = op_n->next; // 0x415f81..
}
bool result = SetHorzSegHeadingForward(hs, op_p, op_n)   // 0x415fc1 (rsi=op_p, rdx=op_n)
              && (hs.left_op->horz == nullptr);          // 0x415fd1 (+0x28), short-circuit
if (result) hs.left_op->horz = &hs;                      // 0x415ffa
else        hs.right_op = nullptr;                       // 0x416004
return result;
```
Note `hs.left_op` is **re-read** after `SetHorzSegHeadingForward` (which may have swapped it).

### `HorzSegSorter::operator()(const HorzSegment& hs1, const HorzSegment& hs2)` — 0x41458a
(`rdi`=this, `rsi`=hs1, `rdx`=hs2)
```
if (!hs1.right_op || !hs2.right_op) return (hs1.right_op != nullptr);   // 0x4145a5 / 0x4145b2 / setne
return hs2.left_op->pt.x > hs1.left_op->pt.x;                           // cmp %rax,%rdx ; setg  (rdx = hs2.x)
```
Used with **`std::stable_sort`** (not `sort`) at `0x41107f` on `horz_seg_list_` (`ClipperBase+0xA8`).

### `ConvertHorzSegsToJoins()` early-out — 0x411004
```
ptrdiff_t j = count_if(horz_seg_list_.begin(), horz_seg_list_.end(),
                       [](HorzSegment& hs){ return UpdateHorzSegment(hs); });  // 0x41103e
if (j <= 1) return;                       // 0x411047 cmpq $0x1 ; 0x41104c jle (signed)
stable_sort(begin, end, HorzSegSorter());
```

### `ClipperBase::AddTrialHorzJoin(OutPt* op)` — 0x416052
```
if (!op->outrec->is_open /*OutRec+0x78, bool*/)          // 0x416066/0x41606a, jne -> skip
    horz_seg_list_.emplace_back(op);                      // horz_seg_list_ = this+0xA8
```
